This is not a subjective "deserved" call—it’s a clear violation of rules and conduct. - Assault includes physical contact (e.g., pushing, hitting, spitting) or verbal abuse that escalates to aggression. Even if the player feels wronged, attacking an official is unacceptable. 2. **No Excuse for Violence** - Even if the referee made a bad call, violence is never justified.
